piCloud.title: Single sign-on
piCloud.description: Signs people in through an OpenID Connect provider, such as SAP IAS, and lets in the members of one group.

issuer.title: Issuer
issuer.description: The provider's issuer URL, such as https://tenant.accounts.ondemand.com. Its redirect URI is this server's /api/plugins/oidc/callback. A client secret, if the provider needs one, comes from PI_CLOUD_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET.

accessGroup.title: Access group
accessGroup.description: Members of this group, from the ID token's groups claim, can sign in. Their first sign-in makes their user.

adminGroup.title: Admin group
adminGroup.description: Members of this group can install plugins, change their settings and restart the server.
